meta.name: clawring
meta.description: Phone calling skill for OpenClaw: agent makes real outbound phone calls to users for alerts, briefings, reminders, and urgent notifications. Managed service, no Twilio setup needed. 100+ countries, 70+ voices.

copy.tagline: 让 agent 自动拨打真人电话通知用户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要 agent 主动打电话通知用户，无需配置 Twilio
copy.tagline_en: Make your agent call users automatically with real voice
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need your agent to make outbound phone calls without Twilio setup

howto.what: 装上后，你的 Claude 能主动给你打电话，用真实语音和你对话。通话中，Claude 可以执行搜索、设置提醒等任务，就像在聊天中一样。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 在特定事件（如构建完成、价格变动、服务器宕机）或定时（如每天早上8点）给你打电话时触发。

say.text: 我的构建完成后给我打电话。
say.note: Claude 会在构建完成时主动拨打电话通知你。

say.text: 每天早上8点给我打电话做简报。
say.note: Claude 会定时拨打电话进行晨间简报。

say.text: 如果比特币跌破5万美元，给我打电话。
say.note: Claude 会监控价格并在条件满足时拨打电话。

howto.what_en: After installation, your Claude can make real outbound phone calls to you and have a voice conversation. During the call, Claude can perform tasks like web search and setting alerts, just like in chat.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to call you upon specific events (e.g., build completion, price change, server down) or on a schedule (e.g., every morning at 8am).

say_en.text: Call me when my build finishes.
say_en.note: Claude will call you when the build completes.

say_en.text: Call me every morning at 8am with a briefing.
say_en.note: Claude will call you daily at 8am for a briefing.

say_en.text: Call me if Bitcoin drops below $50k.
say_en.note: Claude will monitor and call when condition is met.
